words.def: a situation where two meetings or events are planned for the same time.
words.book: I regret to inform you that our scheduled meeting for next Monday, the 10th of February, has to be postponed due to a last-minute scheduling conflict.
uses: Due to a scheduling conflict, could we move our call to Wednesday at 11?
scheduling conflict with the bank meeting, can we do 2 instead?
To avoid scheduling conflicts, please book all PM visits in the shared calendar.
dont: There is an interference in my appointments.

words.def: in a way that suits what has just been said or decided.
words.book: Please let me know which option works best for everyone, and I will make arrangements accordingly.
uses: Please confirm the delivery date and we'll plan the installation accordingly.
prices changed, update the quote accordingly pls
Once we know the total load, we'll size the UPS accordingly.
dont: Tell me and I will arrange on this base.
doo: Let me know and I'll make arrangements accordingly.

words.def: to decide that money, time or people will be used for a particular purpose.
words.book: Can you clarify how much we have allocated for this?
uses: We've allocated two technicians to the data-centre project for the next month.
how much did we allocate for spare parts this quarter?
I suggest we allocate more budget to preventive maintenance.
dont: We specified money for the marketing.
doo: We allocated a budget for marketing.

words.def: estimates of future numbers, such as sales or revenue, based on current data.
words.book: What about the revenue projections for the next quarter?
uses: Attached are the sales projections for the solar division for Q4.
are the Q1 projections final or still draft?
Our projections show a 15% rise in maintenance contract renewals.
dont: The expectations of the sales next year are good.
doo: The sales projections for next year look good.

words.def: to finish a meeting, task or discussion.
words.book: Are there any final comments or questions before we wrap up?
uses: We expect to wrap up the installation by Thursday afternoon.
let's wrap up, i have a site visit at 3
Before we wrap up, let's confirm who's following up on the overdue invoices.
dont: Let's close the meeting and finish it.

words.def: to formally end or pause a meeting.
words.book: Are there any final comments or concerns before we adjourn?
uses: The board meeting was adjourned until next Monday because the figures were missing.
If there's nothing else, the meeting is adjourned.
dont: The meeting is ended now officially.

upgrade.plain: I will cancel the meeting because I have a problem.
pro: I apologize, but I will have to reschedule our meeting.
I will cancel the meeting, I have problem.
The meeting is cancelled from my side because problem.
upgrade.why: اعتذر الأول، وقول ‎reschedule‎ لو هتحدد ميعاد تاني.

upgrade.plain: The meeting is delayed to another time.
pro: The meeting is delayed to other time.
The meeting is late for another day.
The meeting needs to be postponed.

upgrade.plain: Which time is good for you all?
pro: Which time is suitable for you all?
Please let me know which option works best for everyone.
Tell me what time is good for all of you.
upgrade.why: ‎works best for‎ هي الطريقة الطبيعية للسؤال عن الميعاد المناسب.

pro: Shall we put it to a vote?
We do a vote now for this.
upgrade.why: ‎put it to a vote‎ = نطرح الموضوع للتصويت.

upgrade.plain: Raise your hands so I count.
pro: Raise your hands for I count.
Can we get a show of hands?
upgrade.why: ‎a show of hands‎ = تصويت سريع برفع الإيد.

pro: The meeting is over now, you can go.
That concludes our meeting for today. Thank you all.
upgrade.why: اقفل الاجتماع بجملة رسمية وشكر: ‎That concludes …‎
